scope: Development-only resubstitution diagnostic (scenarios 1-120). Not held-out validation, not a fresh blind sample, no final data parsed.

independent_audit.disclosure: The audit's first two attempts failed on auditor-side convention bugs (an incorrect running-MDD reconstruction expression and an off-by-one in first-crossing indexing). Both fixes touched the auditor only; the producer script, protocol, freeze and outputs were never modified after the single producer run.

B_guard.interpretation: The locked one-year support floor (1 - L*release_fraction) * initial real wealth = (1 - 0.25*0.5)*100 = 87.5 cannot be met by any of the 13 primary proposals for the Conservative target 25/30/45 on the calendar development support. The unchanged guard declines to fund B automatically.

E_guard.interpretation: Same unchanged screen: (1 - 0.35*0.5)*100 = 82.5 cannot be met for the Growth target 65/5/30. The guard declines to fund E automatically.

findings.reference_crosscheck: Static references reproduce the previously audited development 5x3 screen exactly: B Conservative 9/120 breaches, E Growth 6/120. Equal-thirds at own horizons: B 20/120, E 0/120 (E's thirds has P10 CAGR -2.32% and lower median growth than the Growth product).
findings.contrast_with_C: Profile C (Balanced 45/5/50, L=40%, floor 80.0) passes the identical initial support screen and was funded 60/60 in the locked final evaluation. The screen's selectivity comes from the interaction of the L-derived floor and target riskiness, not from a profile-specific adjustment.

implications_for_report: The safeguard is one coherent family: suitability screen at onboarding (A/D Review), then the same unchanged execution gate decides whether an assigned product may be auto-funded. Applied unchanged, that gate funds only C; B and E would require human review before investment.

This resolves the apparent 'B/C exceed the 10% reference' tension honestly: static Q1 product references are suitability assignments, never automatic execution approvals, and the guarded service layer confirms it by refusing unattended funding for B/E.

Do NOT present this as evidence that the guard reduces B/E breach rates in execution; no funded guard path exists for B/E. The finding is about the gate's conservatism, not about executed performance.
Equal-thirds at E's own horizon has 0/120 breaches but lower growth (median 3.52% vs 5.00%) and negative P10; it is a hypothetical reference, not the assigned product.
limitations: Resubstitution on development data; guard parameters were selected for C on the same 120 paths.
The one-year support floor is a normative declared convention ((1 - L/2) of current real wealth), not a calibrated loss probability.
A stricter funding gate increases Review workload; no adviser capacity or response model is estimated.
No final-sample counterpart exists for B/E guard arms; none may be created without contaminating the disclosed nonblind protocol.
no_changes_statement: No locked V2b parameter, target, candidate identity, frozen artifact or final evaluation result was modified. All outputs are additive evidence under results/q1_guard_generalization_v1/.
